Method of Attack: Supply-chain attack by injecting malicious code into License.php file in premium FishPig plugins
Malicious code downloads a Linux binary (lic.bin) from license.fishpig.co.uk
Binary is Rekoobe remote access trojan (RAT) that loads configuration, removes malicious files, and mimics system service
RAT lies dormant waiting for commands from Latvia-based C2 server
Attack Vector: Compromise of FishPig's server infrastructure and injection of malicious code into vendor's software
